entities.name: Ferrous Rokiric
entities.description: Legendary Wojek Commander-General who brought the stone Titans into Ravnica.

entities.name: Wojek League
entities.description: Organization charged with law and order, strained by rebellions.

entities.name: Titans of Ravnica
entities.description: Ten massive stone constructs each matching a hundred soldiers.

entities.name: Zobor
entities.description: Tenth and most prominent titan, stationed at the Center of Ravnica.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Magical pact balancing the ten guilds.

entities.name: Decamillennial Celebration

events.summary: Rokiric oversaw the deployment of ten Titans to quell the Golgari and Rakdos rebellions.
events.quote: he oversaw the deployment of ten massive Titans of Ravnica

events.summary: Nine Titans were set at the borders and Zobor at the center of Ravnica.
events.quote: nine of these towering guardians were positioned at the city’s outer borders to deter further unrest.

relations.quote: Ferrous Rokiric was a legendary Wojek Commander-General from Ravnica .
